name: publication-business-manager
description: Publication Business Management & Sales Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.dev:prod: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:prod -w server" "npm run dev:prod -w web"
